topics.title: Nature of Management and Business Organization

subtopics.content: 1.1 - 1.3 Management process, business structures, environment, ethics, and stakeholders
subtopics.objective: Differentiate management from administration; identify manager levels and roles. Compare sole proprietorships, partnerships, limited liability companies, public corporations, and co-operatives. Analyze internal/external business environments, causes of failure, corporate social responsibility, and primary/secondary stakeholders.

subtopics.content: 2.1 - 2.4 Planning, decision making, organizing, directing, and controlling
subtopics.objective: Master planning steps, decision-making processes (programmed vs non-programmed), organizational structures, delegation guidelines, directing elements, motivation theories (Maslow), leadership styles, formal/informal communication channels, and control tools.

subtopics.content: 3.1 - 4.3 ICT, computer applications, Law of Contract, Agency, and Negotiable Instruments
subtopics.objective: Differentiate data and information; apply computer systems to business. Understand essential contract elements, vitiating factors, contract discharge, principal-agent relationships, and negotiable instruments (cheques, bills of exchange, promissory notes).

topics.title: Finance, Financial Institutions, and Government Role

subtopics.content: 5.1 - 6.5 Money, banking, inflation, risk/insurance, stock exchange, government revenue/taxation
subtopics.objective: Understand functions of money, inflation, central/commercial bank roles, monetary policy tools, risk management, insurance principles/policies, stock exchange securities, taxation types, and government expenditure items.

topics.title: International Trade, Developing Economies, and Globalization

subtopics.content: 7.1 - 8.2 International trade, BOP, IMF/IBRD, globalization, and economic integration
subtopics.objective: Compare domestic vs international trade; understand trade documents, absolute/comparative advantage theories, balance of payments corrections, roles of IMF/World Bank/UNCTAD, globalization impact, and economic blocs (ECOWAS, AU, EU, ASEAN).

subtopics.content: 9.1 - 9.6 HR, labour relations, production, marketing, e-Commerce, and business finance
subtopics.objective: Understand HR processes (recruitment, job analysis, appraisal), trade unions/collective bargaining, production processes (job, batch, flow), 4 Ps of marketing mix, product life cycle, branding/packaging, e-commerce, and short/long-term financing.

subtopics.content: 10.1 - 10.2 Entrepreneur traits, business plans, record keeping, small business setup, and sustainability
subtopics.objective: Identify entrepreneur characteristics, structure business plans, maintain business records, manage time, understand procedures for establishing small businesses, overcome challenges, and utilize government support for business sustainability.
